search.snippet: Leather chaps is a part of leather armour that is worn in the legs slot, most commonly by low-level rangers. Low-levelled player mages also often wear these chaps, since they give a slight defence bonuses without a magic attack penalty.
search.title: Leather chaps - OSRS Wiki

search.snippet: To equip leather chaps in OSRS, follow these simple steps: Open your inventory by clicking on the backpack icon. Locate the leather chaps in your inventory. Right-click on the leather chaps and select "Wear" from the drop-down menu.
search.title: How to use Leather Chaps OSRS – GAD Roots

search.snippet: The leather chaps osrs price is one of the most attractive things about this gear. If you are browsing the Grand Exchange and wondering if you should spend your hard-earned GP on leather chaps osrs, the answer is a resounding yes.
search.title: Leather Chaps OSRS: The Ultimate Gear Guide... - LEATHER SPUR

search.snippet: Leather is obtained from tanning a cowhide (costs 1gp). Leather can be used with a needle and thread to be crafted into Leather gloves, leather boots, Leather cowl, leather vambraces, Leather body, a Coif or leather chaps granting Crafting experience.
search.title: Leather | Old School RuneScape Wiki | Fandom

search.snippet: How do you make leather coif Osrs? Leather cowls are leather armour worn on the head, most commonly by low-levelled rangers. Players can make this item through the Crafting skill at level 9 using soft leather, granting 18.5 Crafting experience.
